newsitem.title: USA: FGIC qualifies seven muni issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: FGIC qualifies seven muni issues for insurance.

text.p: Financial Guaranty Insurance Co said it has qualified for bond insurance the following seven municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Belleville Comm. No.522, Ill., $3.9 million general obligation bonds.
--Niles Public Library District, Ill., $3.875 million library GOs.
--Sachem CSD, N.Y., school district bonds $7.2 million.
--Portland, Oregon, $110 million sewer system revenue bonds.
--Grove City Area SD, Pa., $5 million GOs and $5 million GOs.
